text:
Sam: quick huddle on /v1/embeddings routing change. proposal: accept an optional client hint header `X-Embed-Hint: dims=1536;bytes=4096` so router can pick between fast small-batch path or default shard path. low-cost for clients, big perf delta.
Katy: prefer server-side inference when possible. some SDKs don't know dims at send time. can we do both?
Sam: yes 1% incentive for clients to send hint, else server will inspect body and derive dims. but body parsing is heavier so treat hint as advisory.
Jordan: telemetry needs: count of hints provided, route chosen, and whether hint matched parsed dims. add `embeds.hint.present`, `embeds.route.chosen`, `embeds.hint.mismatch`.
Mike: also capture `embeds.split_events` when we chunk a single request into sub-requests. current console shows overall requests only.
Sam: I'd like `split_count` bucketed (0 / 1 / 2+) to avoid high cardinality in metrics.
Katy: Console UX: surface split-rate but sample traces to avoid explosion. toggle to enable detailed view per-tenant.
Jordan: sampling plan: counters for totals always on; 5% sampled spans for full attributes (route_hint, parsed_dims, estimated_units). that gives ratios plus a few traces for debugging.
Mike: edgecases: gzip or base64 wrappers change byte count. need a normalization step before validating hint. otherwise mismatch noise will be huge.
Sam: agree. validation: accept hint if dims within +/-10% of parsed dims after normalization, else mark `hint_mismatch=true`. return `X-Embed-Route` header for debug: `fastpath|sharded|split`.
Katy: privacy note: do not log raw header strings in console (PII risk). console should show sanitized numeric dims/bytes and a sample rate badge.
Jordan: rollout suggestion: 1) internal org canary, 2) expose response header for eng-only, 3) opt-in per-tenant console flag, 4) 10% public traffic, 5) ramp. monitor p95 latency/err rate and split_rate.
Mike: alerts: trigger if `embeds.route.fastpath.p95` > `embeds.route.sharded.p95` * 1.2 for 15m, or if `embeds.hint.mismatch` > 5% sustained over 30m. also track cost-per-request delta when split_count grows.
Sam: metrics names we should standardize: `embeds.hint.provided_total`, `embeds.route.taken_total{fast,shard,split}`, `embeds.split.count_bucket{0,1,2_plus}`, `embeds.hint.mismatch_total`.
ingress-bot: deploy queued: embed-routing-canary v0.9 -> canary-cluster at 2023-10-15T12:30:00Z
Katy: testing checklist: single small vector, large single vector (high dims), batched arrays, gzip-wrapped body, malformed hint, missing hint. verify route and `split_count`.
Jordan: I'll add synthetic load tests to the CI job to exercise normalization and mismatch stats.
Mike: I'll draft an ops playbook with steps: how to pull sampled trace ids, correlate `split_count` with billing spikes, and how to flip tenant opt-in. include runbook commands and dashboards to open.
Sam: nice. heads-up: SDK owners should add helpers to set header automatically for typical clients. we should document in API reference and add code snippets.
Katy: I'll mock a console panel for opt-in plus a small chart for split-rate and mismatch rate. keep default hidden behind feature flag.
Jordan: can you also include a small query for top 20 tenants by `hint_mismatch` for the console? helpful for outreach.
Mike: noted. I'll keep playbook updated and own the alerting thresholds.
Sam: timeline: prototype telemetry + response header by next week, console mock after that, then internal canary. Thanks all.
Katy: 👍
Jordan: on it.
Mike: will start the playbook now.
